takeaways.text: Lines up **Wide (outside)** on **76%** of 229 plays (n=174); also Slot 24% (n=55).
Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **12.7 yd** downfield by the throw vs 11.2 for WRs (deeper) (n=228, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Wide (outside) (76%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.
